title: Customer Success Associate
description:
Role & Responsibilities Act as the primary point of contact for customers and ensure a smooth, professional customer experience. Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with existing customers. Regularly communicate with customers to understand their requirements, concerns, feedback, and expectations. Handle customer queries related to orders, delivery status, invoices, payments, and other service-related matters. Coordinate with Sales, Operations, Purchase, Warehouse, Accounts, and Delivery teams to resolve customer issues promptly. Track customer orders from order placement through delivery and ensure timely follow-up. Proactively follow up on pending orders, delayed deliveries, shortages, replacements, returns, and other open issues. Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, complaints, resolutions, and follow-ups. Identify recurring customer problems and coordinate internally to improve service quality. Collect customer feedback and share relevant insights with management and concerned departments. Monitor customer satisfaction and take proactive steps to prevent customer dissatisfaction or loss. Support customer retention and encourage repeat business through consistent service and relationship management. Prepare regular reports related to customer complaints, pending issues, order status, customer activity, and service performance. Ensure timely escalation of critical or unresolved customer issues to the appropriate senior team member. Follow company policies, SOPs, and service standards while dealing with customers. Assist in improving customer service processes, communication standards, and overall customer experience. Preferred Candidate Profile Graduate in any discipline . 2 to 6 years of experience in Customer Success, Customer Support, Client Servicing, Sales Coordination, Telecalling, or a similar role. Experience in pharmaceutical distribution, FMCG, healthcare, wholesale, or B2B business will be an advantage. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Good interpersonal and relationship-management skills. Customer-focused attitude with a strong sense of ownership and responsibility. Ability to handle customer complaints and difficult situations professionally. Good follow-up and coordination skills. Comfortable communicating with customers over phone calls, WhatsApp, email, and other communication channels . Good working knowledge of MS Excel/Google Sheets and basic computer applications . Ability to maintain accurate records and prepare basic reports. Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple customers and follow-ups simultaneously. Should be proactive, disciplined, and comfortable working in a target- and deadline-oriented environment. Ability to coordinate effectively with multiple internal departments. Fluency in Hindi/Bengali will be preferred, depending on the customer base. Candidates with a problem-solving mindset and willingness to learn will be preferred. 
 Key Skills Customer Relationship Management | Communication | Problem Solving | Follow-up | Coordination | Complaint Handling | Order Management | MS Excel | Reporting | Customer Retention

Key Skills: Client Success,Query Resolution,Client Retention,Escalations,Client Handling,Escalation Management,Customer Satisfaction,Client Interaction

title: Candidate Success & Client Coordinator
description:
We are looking for a Candidate Success & Client Coordinator to join our team in New Barrackpore, Kolkata. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing client and candidate communication, coordinating meetings, understanding requirements, tracking progress, following up on action items, maintaining documentation, and coordinating with mentors and internal teams. The role requires excellent communication, strong organizational skills, effective follow-up, and a proactive, customer-focused approach. 
 Key Responsibilities Communicate regularly with candidates and clients to understand their requirements, concerns, and progress. Schedule and coordinate meetings between candidates, clients, mentors, and internal teams. Maintain regular follow-ups regarding assigned action items, deliverables, and timelines. Track candidate progress, milestones, and ongoing activities. Document meeting discussions, recommendations, action items, and follow-ups. Coordinate with mentors and internal teams to ensure timely completion of requirements. Maintain accurate client and candidate records and project documentation. Monitor pending tasks and ensure timely follow-up and closure. Identify issues or concerns in the candidate/client journey and escalate them appropriately. Ensure a smooth and professional client and candidate experience. Manage multiple candidates, clients, meetings, and coordination activities simultaneously. 
 Required Skills Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. Strong client and candidate coordination skills. Good follow-up and relationship management abilities. Strong organizational and time-management skills. Basic proficiency in MS Excel and Google Sheets . Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities. Proactive approach with strong ownership and accountability. Customer-focused mindset and professional communication. Ability to coordinate effectively with multiple stakeholders. 
 Preferred Candidate Profile 13 years of experience in Customer Success, Client Coordination, Client Relationship Management, Project Coordination, Operations, or a similar role . Experience in a customer-facing or coordination role is preferred. Strong interpersonal and communication skills. Comfortable managing multiple stakeholders and following up on tasks. Ability to work independently while coordinating effectively with internal teams.

title: Front Office Executive
description:
The Front Office Executive (Operations) will be responsible for supporting the daily administrative and operational functions of the showroom. The role focuses on ensuring smooth day-to-day operations, maintaining showroom cleanliness and brand standards, managing inventory, and assisting the internal team to enhance the overall customer experience. 
 Note: This role does not include any sales-related responsibilities. 
 Key Responsibilities: 1. Operational Management: Assist in managing the day-to-day Admin operations of the showroom, ensuring compliance with company policies and procedures. Oversee showroom opening and closing procedures, ensuring all operational tasks are completed accurately and on time. 2. Inventory Management: Monitor and manage stationary & housekeeping inventory, ensuring demo-lifts are well maintained and displays of samples are visually appealing. 3. Showroom Presentation: Ensure the showroom is clean, organized, and visually appealing, adhering to company merchandising standards. Oversee the setup and maintenance of showroom displays, ensuring they are attractive and well-maintained. 4. Customer Service Support: • Provide support to the sales team in handling customer inquiries and ensuring a high level of customer service. Address any operational issues that may arise during the showrooms operation, ensuring prompt resolution. 5. Documentation and Reporting: Maintain accurate records of showroom operations, including inventory counts, client walk ins, and maintenance logs. Prepare and submit regular reports on showroom maintenance reports, inventory, and operational issues to the reporting manager. 6. Maintenance and Facilities Management: • Coordinate with maintenance personnel and vendors to ensure the showroom is well maintained and all equipment is in working order. Handle minor repairs and troubleshooting of showroom equipment and fixtures. 7. Compliance and Safety: Ensure compliance with health and safety regulations, maintaining a safe environment for staff and customers. Conduct regular safety inspections and address any hazards or safety concerns promptly. 
 Qualifications: Bachelors degree (preferred in any field, commonly in Commerce, Business Administration, or Arts), or Diploma holders in Hospitality, Front Office, or Retail Management. 
 Experience: • 0-2 years for entry-level FOEs (Freshers can also be considered if they have strong communication and grooming skills). • Experience in similar roles in retail, hospitality, or front-desk/customer-facing positions is highly preferred. Key Skills Required: • Excellent communication skills (Fluency in English and regional language). • Customer service orientation. • Good interpersonal skills and presentation. • Basic computer knowledge (MS Office, email handling). • Ability to handle walk-in clients, coordinate with internal teams, and manage basic administrative tasks. 
 Grooming & Personality: • Presentable appearance, neat grooming. • Polite and professional behaviour. • Ability to multitask and stay composed under pressure.
